info.name: Pixie Ink
info.description: Pixie Ink is a sweet, bubbly typeface sprinkled with charm. Every letter feels hand‑doodled with a soft, magical touch, like it was written by a tiny fairy with an oversized pen. Rounded curves, cheerful shapes, and a gentle bounce make this font perfect for cute logos, cozy aesthetics, and anything that needs a little extra sparkle.
